A real main line sits near the true mean, so BR is the only column behaving like one (MAE 0.49). DK/FD/CZR post >=7.5 K lines on Andre Pallante (16.9 K%), Bryce Elder (19.8 K%) and Tanner Bibee (19.0 K%) — no book prices a 16.9 K% starter at 8.5. Read those columns as an ALT-LINE LADDER until the source proves otherwise.
